about_the_game:
Created by Michel van der Aa

Award-winning composer and director Michel van der Aa brings his passion for innovative narrative forms to the digital realm. HERE offers a unique blend of cinema and interactive performance. Users can shape the narrative, creating a personalized experience that explores the boundaries of reality and identity.

HERE makes cutting-edge music theater accessible to a diverse audience, including those who might not typically attend traditional venues. Whether you're using VR on your PC or an Apple headset, this app offers a fresh way to engage with contemporary performance, bridging the gap between creator and audience in the comfort of your own space.

Step into a virtual grand theater and be captivated by Julia Bullock's stunning aria from the acclaimed film opera "Upload". Immerse yourself in "Eight," the groundbreaking VR opera installation that has wowed audiences at festivals around the world, soon available in your living room. Explore "The Book of Sand," a VR adaptation of Jorge Luis Borges' novel that pushes the boundaries of digital storytelling. And that's just the beginning...

HERE is produced by the doubleA foundation with support of DigitALL.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 18 GB available space
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 2 OpenXR, Controller support only.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 9 5950X 16-Core Processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 24 GB available space
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 3 with OpenXR, Controller support only.

short_description: Step into the future of immersive storytelling with HERE, a groundbreaking app for PCVR and Apple Vision Pro that brings music theatre into your home.
